subject: Clearway Analytics — request for pilot onboarding without PO
messages:
From: Matt Sullivan <matt.sullivan@clearway.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: pilot onboarding without PO (Clearway Analytics)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking the meeting this morning. Clearway is excited to start the 30-day pilot with Redwood; the engineering team wants to spin up immediately (proof-of-concept uses ~2000 tokens/day).

We ran into procurement on our side: our purchasing process is slow and they ask for a PO to match invoices. For the pilot we’d like to request temporary onboarding so we can invoice you directly without a PO (invoice-only) until the production purchase order is in place. We can provide:
- SOC 2 summary and evidence (redacted)
- W-9 and US tax paperwork
- Pilot SOW with spend cap ($5k max)

Can your procurement/finance accept a temporary no-PO route for this pilot? If needed we’re happy to sign an MSA addendum or a short invoice agreement via DocuSign.

Attaching SOC2 summary and W-9 for your review.

Thanks,
Matt Sullivan
Head of Partnerships | Clearway Analytics
Matt.Sullivan@clearway.ai

Attachments: clearway_soc2_summary.pdf, clearway_w9.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Matt Sullivan <matt.sullivan@clearway.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: pilot onboarding without PO (Clearway Analytics)

Hi Matt — looping in procurement and CS.

Laura: can procurement evaluate a temporary invoice-only onboarding for a small pilot? Clearway proposes a $5k cap and will deliver SOC2 summary + W-9 (attached). Grace, FYI on the scope so CS can set expectations for support.

Quick ask from procurement side if this is potentially approvable:
- Confirmation of spend cap and billing cadence (monthly)
- Evidence of SOC2 summary + W-9 (already attached)
- Point of contact for invoice delivery and PO follow-up (Anna Reyes listed)

Matt — if procurement approves, we’ll add a timeboxed exception and a one-line approval memo to the vendor allowlist.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Matt Sullivan <matt.sullivan@clearway.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: pilot onboarding without PO (Clearway Analytics)

Hi all — I reviewed Clearway's SOC2 summary and W-9. We can support a temporary invoice-only onboarding under the following controls: 

1) Timeboxed exception
   - Valid for up to 60 days or until a PO is established, whichever comes first.
2) Spend limit
   - Hard cap at $5,000 total for the pilot. Any incremental spend requires pre-approval.
3) Evidence & billing
   - Clearway must submit the SOC2 summary (we received), W-9 (received), and a short invoice-only onboarding form (attached checklist) signed by vendor.
4) Invoice terms
   - Net 30; invoices must reference Redwood vendor ID (to be created). No partial shipments beyond the cap.
5) Internal controls
   - Finance will block payments above $5k unless procurement lifts the exception.

Next steps for Matt/Anna:
- Sign the onboarding checklist (onboarding_checklist.pdf) and return.
- Provide the PO lead at Clearway so we can follow with procurement for permanent setup.

Grace — please capture the pilot SOW and confirm support SLAs (email ok). I’ll prepare a vendor allowlist approval memo once the checklist is returned.

If everyone agrees, I authorize a provisional no-PO path for this pilot under the controls above. Attaching the checklist and a short approval template for the vendor allowlist.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: onboarding_checklist.pdf, vendor_allowlist_approval.pdf
